name: Rolling dub bounce
desc: The round sub's livelier sibling: a woody triangle bass bouncing off-beat dub stabs through an eight-cycle Eb-minor-pentatonic walk, a touch of tape delay, iter rotation and a chunked roll at peak with a sine sub anchoring underneath. More forward and syncopated than the held round sub.

code.sparse: note("<eb2 db2 gb1 bb1>").struct("~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~").add(note(${root})).s("triangle").attack(.01).decay(.25).sustain(.2).release(.15).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*1.2,${cut}*2.2).slow(32)).shape(.3).gain(${gain}*.8).delay(.2).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.25).room(.2).every(8,x=>x.rev()).fast(${rate}).orbit(3).play()
code.full: note("<eb2 eb2 db2 gb1 bb1 ab1 db2 gb1>").struct("~ x ~ x ~ x x x").add(note(${root})).s("triangle").attack(.005).decay(.18).sustain(.35).release(.1).lpf(sine.range(${cut},${cut}*2).slow(32)).shape(.5).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(4)).delay(.15).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.2).room(.18).iter(4).fast(${rate}).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: stack(note("<eb2 db2 gb1 bb1 ab1 db2 eb2 gb1>").struct("x ~ x x ~ x ~ x").add(note(${root})).s("triangle").decay(.16).sustain(.3).release(.09).lpf(sine.range(${cut},${cut}*2.4).slow(16)).shape(.5).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(4)), note("<eb1 db1 gb1 bb0>").struct("x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~").add(note(${root})).s("sine").decay(.3).sustain(.5).lpf(${cut}*.7).shape(.3).gain(${gain}*.55)).delay(.12).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.2).room(.16).chunk(4,x=>x.fast(2)).iter(8).fast(${rate}).orbit(3).play()
